note: The worked example for the authored-model format. NOT REACHED BY ANY TILE TODAY, deliberately and unavoidably: modelFor prefers a building_name over a building_type, and all three foundry tiles are named (The Forge, The Foundry x2) with hand-written arms of their own. 408 of the 416 building tiles in Coldwater carry a name, so a type bind draws on almost nothing - the authored format is for buildings that do not exist yet. shapes:smoke reports the unreached binding on every push so this stays visible rather than looking healthy. The model itself: a long low melt hall, a taller charging bay, two stacks and the furnace glow under them, using ty_foundry and ty_foundry_stack, two palettes that were authored for a building nobody ever built.
